objective: Remove the blank grid area in the overview view and make the read-only robot monitoring view legible without weakening its never-green invariants.
decision_supported: Whether the Dashboard is finished enough to be shown as the current operator surface, or whether a further layout pass is still owed.
acceptance: the overview grid holds exactly two column stacks and no panel is a direct grid child
the 448x783 px blank right-hand region at 1600 px is gone and no width renders a blank rectangle between panels
every health domain the API reports has a card, so no published metric is silently dropped
the trend table labels the domains it renders and its per-snapshot total is not confused with the alert-aware overall status
the active alert list renders well-formed markup and states its condition in the language of the page
a clipped metric name keeps its full text available
the monitoring view remains read-only and never reports a status it cannot justify
responsive behaviour at 1080 px 780 px and 390 px is preserved
evidence: dashboard accessibility test output including the layout and monitoring render assertions
browser measurements of the overview grid at 1920 1600 1440 1280 1152 1080 780 and 390 px
browser screenshots of the overview and monitoring views before and after the change
mutation probes that remove the application card the column nesting the list closure the domain labels the metric title and the unit translation and are each confirmed to fail a guarding test
stop_conditions: a frozen event contract fixture meaning or health payload field would need to change
a robot control ROS firmware or emergency-stop interface would be introduced
the monitoring view would gain a write action or a control verb
a status would have to be fabricated to keep a card green
the layout cannot be verified at the target viewport
